changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led exact-meeting to approved-discovery to reviewed-proposal route with price and unsent-state validation.

title: Discovery to Reviewed Proposal
description: Prepare a sourced call brief and an unsent SaaS proposal from approved post-call discovery and current pricing, with distinct seller and commercial review.
setup_prompt: Use Discovery to Reviewed Proposal as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Sales Call Briefing Assistant, Proposal Drafter and optional Account Researcher Crews; bind exact account, opportunity and meeting; inspect current CRM, invitation, approved product claims, discovery-note approval, pricing and commercial owner. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, a validated brief-to-approved-notes-to-draft route, a manual first case and separate sending approval. Show the concrete plan before Builder configures it. Selection does not contact a prospect, send a proposal, change CRM or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Tenant, account, opportunity, meeting, seller and time zone
Authorized current invitation and CRM source or export
Approved post-call discovery notes or a plan to capture/review them
Approved offer, price list/version, currency, discount and scope rules
Commercial reviewer, format, claim and recipient policy
Manual-only or reviewed calendar/CRM event and cadence

pulse_focus.label: Reviewed proposals grounded in discovery
focus_areas: Whether proposal claims reflect approved buyer discovery and current offer/pricing
Whether drafts, approved versions and provider-sent proposals remain distinct
review_when: Discovery notes change, a price list changes, a proposal is reviewed or a customer responds

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and source map
Approved discovery note reference or a truthful pending state
Validated unsent sales-proposal-draft/v1 with exact pricing
Manual case, owner decision and activation choice
